description: I smell gas in my kitchen near the stove, it's been getting stronger for the last hour.
expected_missing_information: Is the gas smell still present now, and have the occupants left the unit?
Has the gas utility's emergency line been contacted?
notes: Emergency override case: gas leak keyword should force urgency=emergency regardless of LLM output. missing_information = dispatch/responder briefing questions (classification is locked).

description: There's water pouring out of the ceiling in my living room and it's spreading fast, please help now.
expected_missing_information: Is the unit directly above accessible so the water source can be shut off?
Is the water near any light fixtures, outlets, or the electrical panel?
notes: Emergency override case: active flooding. missing_information = what the responder needs to act safely and stop the source.

description: No heat at all since last night, it's below freezing outside and my kids are cold.
expected_missing_information: What type of heating system does the unit have (furnace, boiler, baseboard, heat pump)?
Do neighboring units also have no heat?
notes: Emergency override case: no heat during freezing weather. missing_information = what tech/parts to send and whether it is building-wide.

description: I saw sparks coming out of the outlet in my bedroom when I plugged in my lamp.
expected_missing_information: Is there a burning smell, smoke, or scorch marks at the outlet?
Has the breaker for that room been switched off?
notes: Emergency override case: fire/sparks. missing_information = safety briefing for the responder.

description: Part of my bedroom ceiling collapsed last night, there's debris on the floor and a hole above my bed.
expected_missing_information: Is anyone injured, and is the room now closed off?
Is there water or active dripping around the hole, or sagging in adjacent ceiling areas?
notes: Emergency override case: structural collapse. missing_information = injury check and ongoing-risk assessment.

description: My kitchen sink is dripping slowly, it's been like this for a couple weeks.
expected_missing_information: Is the drip coming from the faucet/spout or from the pipes under the sink?
Is any water pooling in the cabinet or on the floor?
notes: Clean, easy case. missing_information = source isolation (parts) and damage check.

description: The dishwasher isn't draining properly, water pools at the bottom after a cycle.
expected_missing_information: Is water leaking or overflowing onto the floor?
What is the dishwasher's make and model?
notes: Clean, easy case. missing_information = urgency check (floor water) and parts (make/model).

description: There's a mouse problem in my apartment, I've seen droppings in the cabinets.
expected_missing_information: How widespread is the activity, and are there visible entry points or gnaw holes?
Are there pets or young children in the unit?
notes: Clean, easy case. missing_information = extent and bait/trap-choice constraints for pest control.

description: My front door lock is jammed and I can't get it to turn, I'm stuck outside right now.
expected_missing_information: Is it the deadbolt or the handle lock that's jammed, and does the key insert but not turn?
Is there an alternate entrance, and is anyone or a pet inside?
notes: Clean but time-sensitive, not a hardcoded emergency category. missing_information = what the locksmith needs and whether there's a faster route in.

description: The bathroom light has been flickering and the outlet nearby is also loose, and honestly the toilet's been running non-stop too.
expected_missing_information: Is the loose outlet sparking, warm to the touch, or discolored?
Does the flickering affect other rooms, or only the bathroom light?
Is the running toilet also leaking onto the floor?
notes: Ambiguous/multi-issue case: electrical + plumbing mentioned together. missing_information = severity of each sub-issue (also determines whether urgency should rise).

description: Something's wrong with my apartment, it's been bothering me for days and I just want someone to look at it.
expected_missing_information: What specifically is wrong — what do you see, hear, or smell?
Where in the apartment is the issue located?
When did it start, and has it gotten worse?
Is anything currently unsafe or unusable (heat, hot water, power, water)?
notes: Genuinely underspecified: these questions are both classification-blocking AND dispatch-blocking. The one case where the model cannot act without answers.

description: The AC unit is making a loud rattling noise and it doesn't seem to be cooling as well as before.
expected_missing_information: Is it a window/wall unit or central AC?
What is the current indoor temperature, and is anyone heat-vulnerable in the unit?
notes: Clean, easy case. missing_information = what tech/parts to send and whether comfort risk raises urgency.

description: My upstairs neighbor's tub overflowed and now there's a wet stain spreading on my ceiling, it looks like it could give way.
expected_missing_information: Is water actively dripping through, or just a stain?
Has the ceiling started to sag or crack?
Has the upstairs overflow been stopped?
notes: Ambiguous case: answers determine whether urgency escalates toward emergency. Good confidence-calibration test.

description: I've called about the same leaking pipe under my sink twice now and it's still not fixed, water is pooling again.
expected_missing_information: Can the sink's shut-off valve be closed to stop the pooling until a plumber arrives?
Is there visible damage to the cabinet, floor, or the unit below?
Which prior work orders cover this leak, and what was attempted?
notes: Recurring-issue/failed-fix case (same property/unit as case_06). missing_information = containment, damage, and repair history.

description: There's a weird smell in the hallway outside my unit and also my smoke detector keeps chirping, not sure if related.
expected_missing_information: Can you describe the smell (rotten eggs/gas, smoke, burning, sewage, musty)?
Is the smell inside the unit or only in the hallway, and is it getting stronger?
Is the smoke detector chirping intermittently (low battery) or sounding a continuous alarm?
notes: Ambiguous, potentially safety-critical. missing_information = the facts that decide whether this is a gas/fire emergency or a low-battery nuisance.

description: My neighbor upstairs throws parties every weekend and it's way too loud after midnight, can someone talk to them?
notes: Out-of-domain: noise/neighbor complaint. Nothing for maintenance to dispatch, so no dispatch-actionable question — recognize and route to property management. Asking follow-up questions here is doing another team's intake.

description: I think I was overcharged on this month's rent, can someone check my account and explain the extra fee?
notes: Out-of-domain: billing question. Same as case_16 — the maintenance triage agent's job is to recognize and route to billing, not to interview the tenant on billing's behalf.

description: The gate code for the parking lot hasn't been working for a few days, I've had to wait for someone to let me in.
expected_missing_information: Is the code failing for everyone or only this tenant?
Was the gate code recently changed or reissued by management?
notes: Borderline shared-property access equipment (still access_lock). missing_information = scope of the fault and whether it's a reissue vs a hardware failure.

description: What is the weather like today?
notes: Out-of-domain: complete non sequitur. Nothing to ask, nothing to dispatch — recognize as not applicable.

description: Not a big deal, but I noticed a faint gas-ish smell near the stove a few days ago, probably nothing. Also the cabinet hinge is squeaky.
expected_missing_information: Is the gas-like smell still present now, or was it only noticed a few days ago?
Is the stove a gas appliance?
notes: Adversarial override test: gas keyword present but downplayed and bundled with a trivial complaint. Deterministic override forces emergency. missing_information = whether the hazard is current (dispatch/responder briefing); the squeaky hinge is a separate trivial item, not missing info.
